title: Settings
description: Your account, how the app looks, and where you are signed in.

mobile.workoutsDescription: Workout tracking will appear here when the native domain is ready.
mobile.nutritionDescription: Nutrition tracking will appear here when the native domain is ready.
mobile.appearanceDescription: Stored on this device. Other devices keep their own appearance setting.
mobile.deleteAccountWarning: Deleting your account cannot be undone. Continue on the web to request a confirmation email.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to everyone you share a workspace with.
profile.photoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Resized before upload, so any photo works.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameTooShort: Name must be at least 2 characters.
profile.emailHint: Contact an administrator to change the address on your account.

account.title: Account
account.signOutHint: Signs you out on this device. Other devices keep their sessions.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Stored in this browser, so your other devices keep their own choice.
appearance.languageHint: Applies to every device you sign in on.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys let scripts and integrations act as you. Treat them like passwords.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.createFailed: Could not create the API key.
apiKeys.createdDescription: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it somewhere safe.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Anything using "{{name}}" stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the API key.

sessions.title: Sessions and devices
sessions.description: Where your account is signed in. Revoke anything you do not recognise.
sessions.revokeOthersFailed: Could not sign out other devices.
sessions.notFreshDescription: For your security, listing your sessions needs a sign-in from the last 24 hours. Sign out and back in to see them.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently remove your account and the data it solely owns.
deleteAccount.warning: This cannot be undone. Workspaces you solely own are deleted, and uploads never linked to anything are removed.
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: We will send a link to your account address. Your account is only deleted after you open it.
deleteAccount.sentDescription: We sent a deletion link to {{email}}. Open it to permanently delete your account. The link expires in 24 hours.
deleteAccount.failed: Could not send the deletion link.
deleteAccount.openHint: Opens the delete-account page for {{workspace}} in your browser. You confirm there and we email you a deletion link; nothing is deleted until you open that link.
deleteAccount.openFailed: Could not open the browser. Visit the web app to delete your account.
